checks.description: The declared run hook starts and writes results.
Application failure propagates as a nonzero workload exit.
Missing or malformed input fails with a diagnostic message.
The packaged env.sh works independently from the login shell.
The application emits a grep-able device execution line when accelerator execution is declared.
The case does not require compute-node network access.
Post-install path substitution works at a fresh absolute package path.
Repeated post-install processing leaves the package usable and unchanged in meaning.
